title: Da Beach
meta_description: Gulf Front with Panoramic Views & Elevator- Da Beach by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Da Beach by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 163 Gulf Shore Drive Details: Da Beach is a stunning Gulf-front retreat located in the highly sought-after Gulf Trace neighborhood of Grayton Beach. Offering approximately 3,727 square feet of interior living space and more than 1,600 square feet of outdoor living, this luxurious home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with five bedrooms and 5.5 baths. High-end finishes, expansive Gulf views, an elevator servicing all three floors, and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces create an exceptional setting for a memorable 30A getaway. Three spacious covered porches overlook the Gulf, providing plenty of room to relax and take in the coastal scenery. Unwind and follow the home's private beach walkover directly to the sugar-white sand. Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park, Gulf Trace provides a peaceful setting along an extraordinary stretch of undeveloped shoreline. Daily beach service with four chairs and two umbrellas is also included, making days along the Gulf even easier to enjoy. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front with Private Beach Walkover -Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Kitchen Island Seating for 5, First-Floor Indoor Bar Seating for 4, Outdoor Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Daily Beach Service: (4) Chairs and (2) Umbrellas -Elevator Servicing All (3) Floors -(3) Gulf-Front Covered Porches -Expansive Gulf Views -Wet Bar -Butler’s Pantry -Outdoor Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Bedrooms / 5.5 Baths First Floor: -Foyer / Guest Entrance -Wet Bar -Half Bath -Indoor Bar Seating for 4 -Outdoor Bar Seating for 4 -Gulf-Front Deck with Seating -Private Beach Walkover -Elevator Access Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) and Covered Deck Access -Bedroom 2 (Bunk Room): Full/Queen Built-In Bunk with Detached Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Butler’s Pantry -Gulf-Front Covered Deck -Outdoor Gas Grill -Pack-n-Play Available in Bedroom 1 Closet* Third Floor: -Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Separate Vanities) and Gulf-Front Covered Porch Access -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Laundry Room -Gulf-Front Covered Porch Please Note: *LSV and on-street parking are strictly prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *The garage is not available for guest vehicle parking. *The living room fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
